messages:
sara: quick follow-up to the probe-horizon RFC. want to nail down tenant probing controls so new clients can warm without letting stealthy probes bypass quotas. tradeoffs: sensitivity vs false positive UX.

jon: agree. what signals are we actually scoring?

sara: core: probe_success_rate, avg_latency, prompt_fingerprint_entropy (hashed), repeated_quota_failures. ancillary: geo spread, client-id churn.

deepa: privacy note: never retain raw prompts. only salted hashes and counts. consider k-anonymity buckets.

sara: plan is salted bucketing + aggregate windows. we can tune bucket granularity per-region.

kevin: recovery semantics? if we soft-shed someone, how do they come back online?
sara: multi-stage flow: stage0 learn (tagged probes), stage1 progressive backoff (limit inflight), stage2 soft-shed (serve cached or lower-qps variant), stage3 hard-block + manual review. auto-decay window for recovery; ops unblock for appeal.

jon: detection math? percentiles or sliding anomaly?
sara: sliding-window anomaly score with tenant-age dampening (small tenants get wider CI).

deepa: config as per-tenant policy blob makes sense, e.g. `horizon_ms, max_inflight, backoff_ms, anomaly_threshold`. runtime must support hot-swap with LRU policy cache.

kevin: telemetry: keep float probe_score internally but emit daily integer buckets for dashboards. keep retention short for raw debug (48h staging, 7d prod sample).

jon: cross-tenant slow-probe evasion?
sara: we'll run a cross-tenant clusterer to flag distributed probe patterns and raise a separate alarm.

kevin: rollout: staging canary -> internal opt-in -> 5% prod soft-shed -> widen after 2w if stable. ops-bot can enable `probe-debug` for tenants.

deepa: estimate telemetry overhead ~10-15% short-term metric increase. SRE to confirm storage.

sara: operator playbook: on soft-shed send structured message with reason code, probe_score, remediation tips; include minimal opaque `X-Redwood-Probe-Info` header on responses.

jon: add unit tests for backoff math and zero-volume edgecases.

sara: I'll open a short RFC addendum with policy shape and auto-decay semantics. tagging @deepa @jon @kevin for review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: probe-horizon canary deployed to staging at 2025-02-13T03:12:00Z :rocket:
